content.text: If you've ever tried to sell digital products online as a creator in Kenya, you know the pain of being locked out of conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-15|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms. Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are off-limits or severely restricted. The result? Your customers can't buy, and you can't collect. But what if there was a way to bypass these limitations and take control of your commerce infrastructure? That's where COREMERCH comes in. We're not a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-start-selling-digital-products-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-12|Crypto Payment]]-honest-side-5|start]]up or a hustle brand. We're an enterprise-grade, sovereign commerce infrastructure company. Our mission is simple: to give digital creators like you the tools to build your own online stores with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. No more renting someone else's platform. It's time to own your infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-11. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

At COREMERCH, we believe in true sovereignty. Our products are not workarounds but base-layer infrastructure. We provide the building blocks for your digital commerce empire, and you own it all. Imagine deploying your own online store in 48 hours, with no ongoing subscriptions or fees. Our stacks include free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. But the real game-changer is NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a mere 0.5% fee. No KYC requirements, no buyer accounts, and instant webhook notifications when payments are confirmed on-chain. This is the infrastructure you've been waiting for.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Our stacks are designed to be plug-and-play, with everything you need to start selling right away. When a customer purchases your product, NOWPayments handles the crypto payment, converting USD prices to the customer's chosen cryptocurrency at transaction time. The payment is verified on-chain, and the webhook fires automatically, triggering your backend logic. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script then handle the delivery of your digital product, whether it's an ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, or software. The product is instantly accessible to the customer, and the order details are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. It's a seamless, automated process that ensures your customers get what they paid for while keeping your costs low and your data secure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Our primary audience is digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or restricted. We're talking about creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, the Philippines, and beyond. These creators have valuable digital products to sell but are hindered by the limitations of conventional payment gateways. COREMERCH is built for them, providing a way to reach a global audience and get paid in a way that's fast, secure, and affordable. By accepting crypto payments, creators can bypass the barriers of traditional finance and tap into a global market. It's a win-win for creators and their customers.
COREMERCH stacks are designed for creators who want full control and ownership of their digital commerce infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The beauty of our stacks lies in the synergy of their components. Free hosting services like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages provide a solid foundation, while Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script offer powerful backend logic capabilities. Supabase and Google Sheets store order data, ensuring you have a record of every transaction. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 deliver your digital products instantly upon purchase. But the heart of our stacks is NOWPayments, which enables you to accept crypto payments from anywhere in the world. The low fees and lack of KYC requirements make NOWPayments a game-changer for international commerce. By combining these tools, we've created a powerful, integrated solution that puts you in control of your digital commerce destiny.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Ready to take control of your digital commerce? Here's how to get started with COREMERCH. First, choose the stack that fits your needs. Our Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for those who want a quick start with GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. For more advanced users, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, along with advanced email security configuration and end-to-end testing. If you prefer to build your own stack, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation and source code for all stacks, including the NOWPayments integration guide and scaling playbook. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all six blueprints and seven templates for instant deployment. With COREMERCH, you're not just buying a product; you're investing in your digital sovereignty.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

COREMERCH's no-KYC payment gateway solution is designed to empower digital creators in Kenya and beyond, offering a way to accept crypto payments and bypass the limitations of traditional payment platforms. By leveraging free and low-cost tools and integrating them with NOWPayments, creators can build their own online stores, accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, and deliver digital products instantly. This infrastructure ensures that creators can sell their products globally, reaching a wider audience and expanding their businesses without the barriers of conventional payment gateways.
NOWPayments enables global crypto payments with low fees, no KYC, and instant webhook notifications.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive package for creators who want to deploy their digital commerce infrastructure quickly and efficiently. It includes all the blueprints and templates needed to build a fully functional online store, complete with hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and crypto payment processing. This kit is ideal for those who want to fast-track their store setup and start selling their digital products to a global audience without the restrictions of traditional payment platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital commerce infrastructure with COREMERCH, follow these steps: 1. Choose your stack: Select the Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or build your own using the Sovereign Blueprint. 2. Set up hosting: Utilize free services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your online store. 3. Configure backend logic: Implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle product delivery and order management. 4. Integrate NOWPayments: Set up a NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments, ensuring low fees and instant webhook notifications. 5. Store order data: Use Supabase or Google Sheets to securely store transaction details, providing a record of all sales. 6. Deliver digital products: Automate product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly. 7. Test and launch: Thoroughly test your setup, ensuring a seamless user experience, and then deploy your store, ready to accept global payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does COREMERCH ensure security and data privacy?

COREMERCH prioritizes security and data privacy by leveraging industry-leading tools and best practices. We use Cloudflare's robust security features, including DDoS protection and encryption, to safeguard your online store. Additionally, we integrate with NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway with a strong focus on security and privacy. NOWPayments does not require KYC, ensuring your customers' anonymity, and it processes payments on-chain, minimizing the risk of fraud or chargebacks.
Can I use my own domain with COREMERCH stacks?

Absolutely! You can use your custom domain with any of our stacks. We provide guidance on setting up custom domains with Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, ensuring your store has a professional and personalized presence on the web. Using your own domain not only enhances your brand but also boosts customer trust and recognition.
How does COREMERCH handle product delivery and file storage?

COREMERCH stacks are designed to deliver digital products instantly upon purchase. We utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file storage and delivery. When a customer purchases your product, the backend logic, powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automatically provides access to the digital product. This process ensures a seamless and immediate experience for your customers.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin. This extensive support ensures that your customers can pay with their preferred cryptocurrency. We recommend networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low transaction fees, often under $0.10, making crypto payments accessible and affordable for your customers.
How does COREMERCH support creators after deployment?

At COREMERCH, we believe in empowering creators to take full ownership of their infrastructure. Once your stack is deployed, you have complete control and ownership. However, we provide comprehensive documentation and guides to help you manage and scale your online store. Our 30-day support period ensures that you have the assistance you need to get started, and our scaling playbook offers insights for future growth.
With COREMERCH, you can deploy a fully functional online store in just 48 hours.
